description.text: A special Scarlet & Violet set released on 18 July 2025 beside White Flare, the two together holding all 156 Pokémon first found in Unova. Black Bolt has Snivy's line up to Serperior ex and the Legendary and Mythical Zekrom ex and Meloetta ex, more than 65 illustration rares, one for each Pokémon, and parallel cards with Poké Ball patterns. Its 86 cards go up to 172 with secret rares, ending with a Zekrom ex in the new Black White Rare, beside a Victini found in both sets.
